body.kid: They pick it up on playgrounds, in jokes, online. So we don’t lecture - we hand kids an eraser and a pencil, and let them fix it themselves.
body.adult: It just gets quieter - in who we hire, who we date, who we expect to ‘settle down.’ But anything learned can be unlearned.

kid.body: Spot the patterns and assumptions hiding in everyday moments.
Get curious about why things are the way they are.
Think about fairness, impact, and other points of view.
Make choices that challenge stereotypes - and mean it.

adult.body: Catch the assumptions running on autopilot.
Ask where the ‘obvious’ actually came from.
Sit with how it lands - and on whom.
Make the fairer call, even when it’s the harder one.
